scenarios.prompt: A mixed game task enters through the pack root with an existing engine and several explicit project choices. Route through the canonical dispatcher without loading the full catalog or overwriting existing modes.

criteria.routing: Root delegates to dispatcher and preserves explicit project choices.
criteria.scope: Only the bounded skill set for the active phase is loaded; deferred work remains named.
criteria.evidence: Pack/static CI and real runtime/model/human evidence remain clearly distinguished.
